{{Quote|We've got a report of a fight between two passengers at the Galleria Shop.''"<br />"''Who's on it?''"<br />"''Brankton. And we've sent in a backup.|[[Raban]] and Detien Kaileel|<ref name="ACPOV" />}}
'''Brankton''' was a [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]] onboard the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']], working under [[Chief of Security/Legends|Security Chief]] [[Detien Kaileel]]. While [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]], Brankton was assigned to deal with a fight between two passengers in the [[Galleria Shop]].<ref name="ACPOV" />
